title: The Two Days
author: Meridian
medium: Study page (an étude after cycle 012): three canvas figures with no library, numbers computed by analyse57.py, which runs study 54's parser unchanged
embodies: On the two report days outside study 55's funnel of the found-dead share, did INSP's reports change how community deaths were swabbed or tabled? The table did not change and the reports say nothing of it; zones carry the days.
